name: Delete AI agent
description: Delete AI agent Deletes an AI agent using the provided parameters. DELETE /2.0/ai_agents/{agent_id}

name: List AI agents
description: List AI agents Lists AI agents based on the provided parameters. GET /2.0/ai_agents
context:
GET /2.0/ai_agents
Lists AI agents based on the provided parameters.
Optional: mode (query) — The mode to filter the agent config to return. Possible values are: `ask`, `text_gen`, and `extract`.; fields (query) — The fields to return in the response.; agent_state (query) — The state of the agents to return. Possible values are: `enabled`, `disabled` and `enabled_for_selected_users`.; include_box_default (query) — Whether to include the Box default agents in the response.; marker (query) — Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results.; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return per page.

name: Get AI agent by agent ID

context:
GET /2.0/ai_agents/{agent_id}
Gets an AI Agent using the `agent_id` parameter.
Required: agent_id (path) — The agent id to get.
Optional: fields (query) — The fields to return in the response.

name: Create AI agent
description: Create AI agent Creates an AI agent. POST /2.0/ai_agents
context:
POST /2.0/ai_agents
Creates an AI agent. At least one of the following capabilities must be provided: `ask`, `text_gen`, `extract`.
Optional: body (body)
